scripts.dev:site:stable: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force; if (Test-Path 'apps/site/.next') { cmd /c rmdir /s /q apps\site\.next }; if (Test-Path 'apps/site/.next-devcache') { cmd /c rmdir /s /q apps\site\.next-devcache }; npm run dev --workspace @ir/site -- -p 3010"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ir/site && npm run build --workspace @ir/sistema
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @ir/site && npm run typecheck --workspace @ir/sistema
